_doc: Real-device benchmark gates, checked by scripts/ci_test_report.py --gates. Keyed by the benchmark JSON's context.build.device; a device not listed (CI's emulator, other phones) is reported, never gated. A gate is the reference median (or percentile) times (1 + margin). g0q (Galaxy S22+) is the benchmark phone since 2026-10-27; every test stayed in the reference state, so it gates seven of the eight tests (scrub150FramesWithPhotos stays report-only); see docs/perf/samsung-g0q-baseline.md. oriole holds the Pixel 6 tests that stayed in the reference state on 2026-10-05; its startup cold and warm start and the wizard cold start never got one. material_testing's oriole numbers were measured on its own app (com.indicvision.semper.materialtesting) and are not copied here. See docs/app/TESTING.md, 'Real-device gates'.
_state: A result is gated only if its test ran at or below maxThermalStatus (PowerManager; 0 = none) and on a charger, at start and end, as recorded in *deviceState.json (TD-135, ADR-008). abMargin: scripts/startup_ab.py fails a candidate whose pooled median is more than this over the reference build's, run interleaved on the same phone.
_micro: microAbMargin: scripts/micro_ab.py, in the CI benchmark job, fails a PR whose HotPathMicroBenchmark median timeNs is more than this over its base build's, both run interleaved (A B B A) on the same emulator (TD-199).
